bss.topic: Plantas e mapas simples: legenda e símbolos

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: O que é uma planta, em geografia?
options: um desenho de um lugar visto de cima
uma foto de um lugar visto de lado
questions.answer: um desenho de um lugar visto de cima
questions.hint: Pense em como um passarinho veria a sala voando bem alto.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Em uma planta, de que ponto de vista o lugar é desenhado?
questions.hint: Imagine olhar o chão de um lugar bem alto.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: O que é a legenda de um mapa?
options: a explicação do que cada símbolo significa
o nome de quem desenhou o mapa
a data em que o mapa foi feito
questions.answer: a explicação do que cada símbolo significa
questions.hint: Ela ajuda você a "ler" os desenhos do mapa.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Como se chama o pequeno desenho que representa alguma coisa no mapa, como uma árvore ou uma casa?
questions.hint: É algo que "está no lugar" de outra coisa.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Na planta de uma sala de aula, vários retângulos pequenos em fileiras provavelmente representam:
questions.hint: Pense no que fica arrumado em fileiras no chão da sala.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Na legenda de muitos mapas, a cor azul costuma representar:
questions.hint: Pense na cor do mar nos desenhos.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Na legenda de muitos mapas, a cor verde costuma representar:
questions.hint: Pense na cor das folhas das árvores.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Em que parte do mapa você procura para saber o que significa cada símbolo?
questions.hint: Costuma ficar num quadrinho no canto do mapa.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Por que usamos símbolos em vez de escrever o nome de tudo no mapa?
options: para o mapa ficar mais simples de ler
porque é proibido escrever no mapa
questions.answer: para o mapa ficar mais simples de ler
questions.hint: Imagine um mapa com palavras escritas em todos os cantinhos.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Rafa está desenhando a planta da escola. Qual símbolo é mais fácil de entender para mostrar o bebedouro?
questions.hint: Um bom símbolo lembra a coisa que representa.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Uma planta mostra o lugar de que tamanho, comparado com o lugar de verdade?
questions.hint: Pense se a planta da escola caberia numa folha de papel.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Qual destes lugares é melhor representado por uma planta?
questions.hint: A planta mostra lugares pequenos com muitos detalhes.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: O que precisa aparecer em uma legenda?
options: cada símbolo e o seu significado
o nome de todos os alunos
questions.answer: cada símbolo e o seu significado
questions.hint: A legenda liga um desenho a uma explicação.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Na planta de uma casa, onde costuma aparecer a porta?
options: como um círculo no meio do quarto
questions.hint: Pense por onde as pessoas entram e saem de um cômodo.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Imagine a planta do seu quarto. Escolha dois objetos e diga que símbolo você usaria para cada um.
questions.hint: Pense em formas simples que lembrem cada objeto.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Por que um mapa sem legenda pode ser difícil de entender?
questions.hint: Pense no que você faria se visse um símbolo que não conhece.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: What is a prefix?
options: letters added to the start of a word
letters added to the end of a word
questions.answer: letters added to the start of a word
questions.hint: Think about where 'pre' happens: before.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Which word has a prefix?
questions.hint: Look for extra letters added before the word 'star'.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: What is the root word in 'superhero'?
questions.hint: Take away the prefix and see what word is left.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: What does the prefix 'super-' mean?
questions.hint: Think about what makes a superhero different from a hero.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: What does the prefix 'anti-' mean?
questions.hint: Think about what an anti-slip mat does to slipping.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: What does the prefix 'auto-' mean?
questions.hint: An automatic door opens without anyone pushing it.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Add the prefix 'super' to 'market' and write the new word.
questions.hint: Join the two parts with no space.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Add the prefix 'auto' to 'graph' and write the new word.
questions.hint: Join the two parts with no space.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: If you turn something anticlockwise, which way does it go?
options: the opposite way to a clock's hands
the same way as a clock's hands
questions.answer: the opposite way to a clock's hands
questions.hint: Remember what 'anti-' means.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Which prefix completes the word for a liquid that stops a car's water from freezing: ___freeze?
questions.hint: The liquid works against the freezing.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: An autobiography is a book about someone's life written by...
questions.hint: Remember what 'auto-' means.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Choose the correct word: The shop sold food, toys and clothes — it was a huge ___.
questions.hint: Which prefix means 'bigger or more than'?

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Which prefix can you add to 'pilot' to name a system that flies a plane by itself?
questions.hint: The system works on its own.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Which word does NOT have a prefix?
questions.hint: Try removing the first letters: is a real word left?

questions.subject: en
questions.q: 'Supersonic' means faster than the speed of sound. Which part of the word means 'more than'?
questions.hint: Look at the start of the word.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Explain how adding 'anti-' changes the meaning of 'clockwise'.
questions.hint: Think about which way a clock's hands move.

en_read.topic: Stories from other cultures: Anansi tales

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: What kind of animal is Anansi in most traditional tales?
questions.hint: He has eight legs and spins webs.

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: Where in the world do Anansi stories first come from?
questions.hint: They began with storytellers in countries such as Ghana.

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: What do we call a character who uses clever tricks to get what they want?
questions.hint: The word comes from 'trick'.

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: Which word best describes Anansi?
questions.hint: He always has a clever plan.

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: How were folk tales like the Anansi stories first shared?
options: by being told aloud from person to person
questions.answer: by being told aloud from person to person
questions.hint: Think about how stories travelled long before books.

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: In a famous tale, Anansi makes a deal with the Sky God to win...
options: all the stories in the world
questions.answer: all the stories in the world
questions.hint: That is why these tales are sometimes called 'spider stories'.

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: To win the stories, Anansi has to capture dangerous creatures. Which of these is one of them?
questions.hint: Think of an animal that lives in a warm forest.

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: In 'Anansi and the Pot of Wisdom', what does Anansi want to do with the wisdom?
options: give it back to the Sky God
questions.hint: Think about whether Anansi is generous in this story.

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: How does the story of the Pot of Wisdom end?
options: the pot breaks and wisdom spreads around the world
the pot is buried for ever
questions.answer: the pot breaks and wisdom spreads around the world
questions.hint: The ending explains why everyone has a little wisdom.

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: Anansi tales travelled across the sea and are still told today in which region?
questions.hint: Think of warm islands where many people have West African roots.

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: Why do many Anansi tales take place in forests, villages and farms?
options: they show the places where the storytellers lived
spiders can only live in forests
the stories were written in a big city
questions.answer: they show the places where the storytellers lived
questions.hint: A story's setting often reflects the culture it comes from.

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: Which of these is a typical feature of a folk tale?
questions.hint: Think about what the listener should learn.

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: Anansi's tricks sometimes go wrong for him. What lesson does this often teach?
options: being greedy can get you into trouble
always run as fast as you can
questions.answer: being greedy can get you into trouble
questions.hint: Think about why his plans fail.

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: Anansi is small but often beats much bigger animals. What does he use instead of strength?
questions.hint: A trickster wins with ideas.

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: Why do you think a small spider makes a good trickster hero?
questions.hint: Think about how a small creature must survive among big ones.

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: Would you like Anansi as a friend? Give one reason.
questions.hint: Think about his good and bad qualities.
